content.text: A new Google classroom update made the home widgets extend to fill the width of the screen
This behaviour is now off by default, where the width can be adjusted in the home layout settings (Accessible through the button on the home page, as shown below)
From here you can also re-enable the automatic resizing system, should you wish to do so.

sections.title: Other Changes
items: - The 'Click the icon to customise' tip on the sidebar now has a dismiss button to prevent it from showing on unedited icons

sections.title: Closing Notes
items: Please report any bugs or request changes through the 'Feedback' button in the settings. Thank you for using Modern Classroom!
